findings.defect: workspace-write depended only on a scenario flag and admitted Java or selection cases if misdeclared.
findings.resolution: Shared prepare/run guard limits bounded_local_runtime to non-selection WR-H01 and WR-N01 of ss-windows-runtime; unknown modes rejected.

findings.defect: TimeoutExpired or invalid native JSON prevented trace and freeze finalization.
findings.resolution: Preserve valid native events, diagnostics, trace and freeze; timeout remains 900 seconds, no retry or cleanup, native exit_code is null on timeout.

findings.defect: Postexecution source or artifact assertions prevented a complete frozen diagnostic.
findings.resolution: Record source/request/prompt integrity errors, freeze admissible text artifacts recursively, inventory rejected artifacts, capture copy diagnostics.

findings.defect: The collector could return zero despite missing turn.completed or missing response.
findings.resolution: Separate native exit_code and collector_exit_code; require completion, nonempty response and no collection errors; leave qualification_status NOT_REVIEWED.

limitations: This review verifies the collector, not candidate business qualification.
C preparation manifests were still being authored; final source/input allowlists require their own preparation review.
Exact candidate full-body tool loading and real Windows runtime results must be proved by future native traces.
Reconstructed catalogue is local discovery evidence, not a model request capture.
Timeout does not attest process-tree cleanup; inspect the owned attempt state before any separately authorized new attempt.
